briefs.title: Why Did Amazon Suspend 21 Air After the Miami Cargo Plane Crash?
briefs.description: Amazon paused operations with 21 Air after Flight 7598 overran a Miami runway and killed five people; the NTSB has not yet determined a probable cause.

briefs.title: Can Trump’s New USPS Mail-Ballot Rules Take Effect for the 2026 Midterms?
briefs.description: Two federal judges have blocked new USPS mail-ballot requirements for the 2026 midterms while the Supreme Court considers an emergency appeal.

briefs.title: What Did the Judge Rule About FEMA’s 50% Staffing Cut?
briefs.description: A federal judge ruled that DHS acted unlawfully in directing FEMA toward a 50% workforce cut; the remedy and final staffing consequences remain unresolved.

briefs.title: Charlie Kirk Memorial Statue Vandalized in Phoenix
briefs.description: A memorial statue of Charlie Kirk outside Turning Point USA's Phoenix headquarters was defaced with red paint; police are investigating and no suspect has been identified.

briefs.title: Trump Says U.S. Will Lift 10% Tariff on Irish Whiskey
briefs.description: President Donald Trump says the United States will remove its 10% tariff on Irish whiskey, though implementation details and timing remain unclear.

briefs.title: Tom Tiffany Plane Makes Emergency Landing in Lake Wausau
briefs.description: Rep. Tom Tiffany and a pilot escaped with minor injuries after a small plane lost power and made an emergency water landing in Lake Wausau, Wisconsin.

briefs.title: What the Hurricane Forecast Cone Really Means
briefs.description: A source-based explainer of the National Hurricane Center forecast cone, model guidance, forecast uncertainty, and why impacts can occur outside the cone.
